visual_identity.color_palette: Deep slate-grey skin with subtle 'burnt-orange' mottling along the high-spine ridge; pale ash-grey underbelly.
visual_identity.texture: Leathery skin with fine, pebbled scales; the dorsal ridge features slightly larger, thickened scales.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: A continuous high ridge of muscle and bone from neck to tail; large, powerful thumb claws; thick brow ridges.

anatomy_constraints.head: Long, deep skull with narrow snouts; prominent bony ridges above the eyes; large expressive yellow eyes.
anatomy_constraints.limbs: Robust arms with three fingers and large claws; powerful, thick-set hind legs built for stability and power.
anatomy_constraints.body: Massive theropod frame with exceptionally tall neural spines forming a thick, muscular ridge along the back.

visual_logic.subject: A powerful, stalking Acrocanthosaurus on the move.
visual_logic.action: Navigating a muddy flood plain, its high-spine ridge catching the midday sun.
visual_logic.environment: Background features the greyish-green siltstones of the Antlers formation with cycad groves and early flowering plants.

personality: The 'High-Spined Stalker'—methodical, powerful, and intimidating. He moves with a heavy, purposeful gait.
